schemes.title: Rajiv Aarogyasri Health Scheme (Aarogyasri Card)
schemes.department: Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department, Telangana
schemes.brief: Free treatment worth up to Rs.10 lakh a year per family for serious illnesses and operations, such as heart, cancer, kidney, brain and accident cases, covering about 1,835 listed treatments, at government hospitals and at private hospitals that have joined the scheme (network hospitals) in Telangana. Treatment is cashless: the Aarogyasri Trust pays the hospital, not you. There is no form to fill: your white ration card (Food Security Card) is your proof, and the Aarogyamitra at the hospital desk registers you on the spot.
schemes.benefit: Up to Rs.10 lakh a year per family, cashless, for listed treatments
eligibility: Families holding a Telangana Food Security Card (white ration card), or an Aarogyasri health card already issued to the family
Every member named on the card is covered: head of family, spouse, children and dependent parents
Orphan children are being given their own Aarogyasri cards through the Women & Child Welfare Department
Only treatments on the Aarogyasri list are covered, at a government or network hospital. Ordinary OPD visits are not covered
Government employees and pensioners are not covered here. They use the separate Employees Health Scheme (EHS)
documents: Food Security Card (white ration card) or Aarogyasri health card, the original
Aadhaar card of the patient (the original, for fingerprint or face check)
Mobile number for updates
Old prescriptions, scan and test reports, if you have any
Referral letter from a PHC, government hospital or health camp, if you have one
schemes.submitAt: Go to the Aarogyamitra help desk (Aarogyasri counter) at any government hospital (Area, District or Teaching hospital) or at an Aarogyasri network private hospital. The Aarogyamitra at your PHC can tell you which hospitals are in the scheme. Take the original white ration card or Aarogyasri card, the patient's Aadhaar and any old reports. The Aarogyamitra checks the card online, takes the patient's photo and fingerprint, and registers the case. For a listed treatment, you pay nothing at any stage.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card number
demoFields.hint: Printed on your white ration card. Once the Aarogyamitra types it in, everyone on the card comes up.

demoFields.label: Patient name (as on the card)
demoFields.hint: Must match the name on the ration card. If the spelling differs, show your Aadhaar as well.

demoFields.label: Relation to head of family
demoFields.hint: How the patient is related to the person named first on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Patient Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: The fingerprint or face check is done on this Aadhaar, so bring the original card.

demoFields.label: Age / gender
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: Updates about approval and discharge come to this number.

demoFields.label: District / Mandal / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives now.

demoFields.label: Complaint / illness
demoFields.hint: Say it in your own words. The doctor writes down the illness after checking the patient.

demoFields.label: Hospital / department
demoFields.hint: Filled in by the Aarogyamitra according to the department you are sent to.

demoSteps: Keep the white ration card and the patient's Aadhaar ready. If you are not sure a hospital is in Aarogyasri, ask the Aarogyamitra at your PHC or call 104.
At the hospital, go to the Aarogyamitra desk first, not the cash counter. Show the card. The Aarogyamitra registers the patient online, with a photo and fingerprint.
The doctor examines the patient and orders tests. If the treatment is on the list, the hospital asks the Aarogyasri Trust online for approval (pre-authorisation).
Approval usually comes within hours, and at once in an emergency. The Aarogyamitra tells you when it is approved.
The operation, medicines and hospital stay are free. Do not pay any money. If anyone asks you to pay, refuse and call 104.
At discharge, sign the discharge papers and collect your medicines and the date of your follow-up visit. Follow-up check-ups for the same treatment are also free.
schemes.helpline: Aarogyasri call centre 104; Aarogyasri Health Care Trust, Hyderabad 040-23547107

schemes.title: Rythu Bharosa (Rs.12,000 per Acre for Farmers)
schemes.brief: Telangana gives farmers Rs.12,000 per acre a year for crop costs, paid as Rs.6,000 per acre before each season (Vanakalam and Yasangi) straight into the farmer's bank account. Rythu Bharosa replaced the old Rythu Bandhu scheme from 26 January 2025. Every pattadar whose farmland is recorded in Bhu Bharati (earlier Dharani) is included automatically, with no new application each season. A new farmer, or one whose money is not coming, gives bank and passbook details to the Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) of the cluster.
schemes.benefit: Rs.12,000 per acre a year (Rs.6,000 per acre each season)
eligibility: Pattadar (land owner) whose farmland is recorded in the Bhu Bharati (earlier Dharani) land records
Tribal farmers holding forest-rights (ROFR) pattas are also eligible
Money is paid only for land fit for farming. House plots, layouts, real-estate ventures, mines, roads and land taken for projects are left out
A bank account in the farmer's own name, linked with Aadhaar
Tenant farmers are not covered. Landless farm labourers have a separate scheme (Indiramma Atmiya Bharosa)
documents: Pattadar passbook (PPB), copy
Aadhaar card
Bank passbook front page with account number and IFSC
Mobile number
Aadhaar consent form, signed (the AEO gives it)
Mutation / Bhu Bharati record if the land was bought or inherited recently
schemes.submitAt: Give the filled Rythu Bharosa Bank Details Collection Form to the Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO) of your cluster at the Rythu Vedika, or at the Mandal Agriculture Office. Attach copies of the pattadar passbook, Aadhaar and bank passbook, and sign the Aadhaar consent form. The AEO checks the details, signs the form and uploads it on the Rythu Bharosa portal. AEO mobile numbers are under Contact Us on rythubharosa.telangana.gov.in.

demoFields.hint: As in the passbook.

demoFields.hint: The farmer's own Aadhaar. It must be the same one linked to the bank account.

demoFields.label: PPB (pattadar passbook) number
demoFields.hint: The number on the front of your pattadar passbook.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: The bank's SMS for each payment comes to this number.

demoFields.label: Bank name
demoFields.hint: The bank where you want the money.

demoFields.label: Branch name
demoFields.hint: As printed in the bank passbook.

demoFields.label: Bank account number
demoFields.hint: Check every digit against the passbook. A wrong digit is the most common reason money does not arrive.

demoFields.hint: 11 letters and numbers printed in the passbook.

demoSteps: Make sure your land is correctly recorded in Bhu Bharati and you have the pattadar passbook. Mutation of bought or inherited land must be finished first.
Get the Bank Details Collection Form from the AEO, or download it. Fill in your name, Aadhaar, passbook number, mobile number and bank details, and sign it.
Give it to the AEO at your Rythu Vedika with copies of the passbook, Aadhaar and bank passbook. The AEO checks and uploads it on the portal.
Before each season the government releases the money, usually to small holdings first and then to larger ones. Rs.6,000 per acre is credited to your account by DBT.
Check the bank SMS or your passbook. If neighbours were paid and you were not, ask the AEO to check your status on the portal. The usual reasons are an Aadhaar-bank mismatch or a closed account.
If the problem stays, complain to the Mandal Agriculture Officer, then to the District Agriculture Officer or the Collector's grievance cell.
schemes.helpline: Your cluster AEO and Mandal Agriculture Officer (numbers under Contact Us on rythubharosa.telangana.gov.in); Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551

schemes.title: Mahalakshmi (Free Bus Travel for Women and Rs.500 Gas Cylinder)
schemes.department: Government of Telangana: TGSRTC (free bus) and Civil Supplies Department (gas subsidy)
schemes.brief: Under Mahalakshmi, one of Telangana's six guarantees, since 9 December 2023 women, girls and transgender persons living in Telangana have travelled free in TGSRTC Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary and Metro Express buses: show an ID and take the zero ticket. Families with a white ration card who applied through Praja Palana get each LPG cylinder for Rs.500: you pay the full price on delivery and the rest comes back to your bank account. The promised Rs.2,500 a month for women heads of family has not started yet, and there is no application open for it (October 2026).
schemes.benefit: Free state bus travel for women; LPG cylinder for Rs.500
eligibility: Free bus: any woman, girl or transgender person living in Telangana, of any age or income, for travel within Telangana
Free bus is valid in Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary and Metro Express buses, not in Deluxe, Super Luxury or AC buses
Rs.500 gas: the family holds a Telangana Food Security Card (white ration card)
Rs.500 gas: the family has an active domestic LPG connection and applied for this in Praja Palana or later at the MPDO / municipal office
Rs.500 gas: the number of cylinders is limited to what the family used on average in the last three years
documents: Bus: Aadhaar card or any government photo ID with a Telangana address (voter ID, driving licence)
Gas: Food Security Card (white ration card)
Gas: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Gas: gas consumer book or latest cylinder bill showing the consumer number and agency
Gas: bank passbook of the account linked to the gas connection
Gas: Praja Palana receipt number, if you applied earlier
schemes.submitAt: Free bus: there is nothing to apply for. Get into a Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary or Metro Express bus, show your Aadhaar or other Telangana ID to the conductor and take the zero-fare Mahalakshmi ticket. Rs.500 gas: if your family was left out, fill the Praja Palana application (tick Mahalakshmi, Rs.500 gas cylinder) at the Praja Palana counter in your MPDO office (villages) or municipal / GHMC circle office (towns). Attach copies of the white ration card, Aadhaar, gas consumer book and bank passbook, and keep the receipt with the application number.

demoSteps: Free bus: board a Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary or Metro Express bus, show your Aadhaar or other Telangana ID to the conductor and take the zero ticket. Girls of any age travel free too.
Rs.500 gas: check that your white ration card is linked with Aadhaar and that your gas connection is active.

If you did not apply in Praja Palana, fill the form at the MPDO or municipal office. Tick Rs.500 gas cylinder, write the gas consumer number, the company and how many cylinders you use a year, attach copies and take the receipt.
Officials check the ration card and gas connection. Your name is then added to the Mahalakshmi gas list that goes to the oil companies.
Book the cylinder as usual and pay the full price to the delivery person.
Within a few days, the amount above Rs.500 is credited to the bank account linked to your gas connection. If it does not come, ask at the gas agency and the MPDO office.
schemes.helpline: TGSRTC enquiry 040-69440000 / 040-23450033; Civil Supplies toll free 1967 (gas subsidy and ration card)

schemes.title: Gruha Jyothi (Free Electricity up to 200 Units)
schemes.department: Energy Department, Telangana: TGSPDCL, TGNPDCL and CESS Sircilla
schemes.brief: Your home gets a zero electricity bill for every month it uses 200 units or less. It covers one home connection for each family with a white ration card linked to Aadhaar, and the bill stays in the house owner's name, so tenants get it too. If a month's use goes above 200 units, the whole month's bill must be paid, not only the extra units. Families who applied in Praja Palana were added automatically; others apply at the MPDO or municipal office.
schemes.benefit: Zero bill for every month the home uses 200 units or less
eligibility: Family holds a Telangana Food Security Card (white ration card) linked with Aadhaar
One home (domestic) electricity connection per family. The house can be rented
The application is entered in the Praja Palana portal with the ration card and the connection's USC number
The connection is used only for the home. Using it for a shop or business is an offence
Monthly use is 200 units or less. Above 200 units the full bill is payable for that month
documents: Latest electricity bill showing the USC (unique service connection) number
Food Security Card (white ration card)
Aadhaar card of the head of the family
Mobile number
Praja Palana receipt number, if you applied earlier
schemes.submitAt: Give the Praja Palana (Gruha Jyothi) application at the Praja Palana counter in your MPDO office (villages) or the municipal office or GHMC circle office (towns). Attach copies of the white ration card, Aadhaar and the latest electricity bill showing the USC number. If you applied before but still get a bill, ask the same office to correct the ration card or USC number in Praja Palana. Take the receipt and show it at your electricity section office (AE office).

demoFields.hint: As on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar number
demoFields.hint: Aadhaar of the head of the family.

demoFields.label: Food Security Card number
demoFields.hint: From the white ration card. Without it the scheme cannot be linked.

demoFields.label: Mobile number
demoFields.hint: A number you use.

demoFields.label: Address
demoFields.hint: The address where this electricity connection is.

demoFields.label: Monthly power consumption (units)
demoFields.hint: See 'units consumed' on your bill. Only months of 200 units or less get a zero bill.

demoFields.label: Electricity service connection (USC) number
demoFields.hint: The USC number printed on the bill, not the meter number. One mistake here and the zero bill does not come.

demoFields.label: Name on the electricity bill
demoFields.hint: If you rent, this can be the owner's name. The name on the bill is not changed.

demoSteps: Find the USC number on your latest electricity bill, and keep the white ration card and Aadhaar ready.
Go to the Praja Palana counter at the MPDO or municipal office. Fill the form with the units you use and the USC number, attach copies and take the receipt.
The office enters it in the Praja Palana portal, and the power company links your ration card to your connection.
From the next billing month, the meter reader gives a zero bill whenever the month's use is 200 units or less.
Watch your use. If it crosses 200 units, that whole month's bill must be paid. The zero bill comes back the next month you stay within 200.
Still getting a bill? Take the receipt to your electricity section (AE) office, or call 1912, and ask them to link your connection.
schemes.helpline: Electricity complaints 1912; TGNPDCL toll free 1800-425-0028; your MPDO or municipal office for the application

schemes.title: Kalyana Lakshmi Pathakam (Rs.1,00,116 Marriage Help)
schemes.department: SC Development, Tribal Welfare and BC Welfare Departments, Telangana
schemes.brief: The Telangana government gives a one-time Rs.1,00,116 for the marriage of a girl from an SC, ST, BC or EBC family, or Rs.1,25,145 if the bride has a disability. The money is paid into the bride's mother's bank account. Apply after the wedding on the Telangana ePASS site, yourself or at a MeeSeva centre, then take the printout and documents to the Tahsildar's office for checking. Brides from minority communities apply under Shaadi Mubarak instead.
schemes.benefit: Rs.1,00,116 one time (Rs.1,25,145 for a bride with a disability)
eligibility: The bride is from an SC, ST, BC or EBC family and lives in Telangana
Parents' total income: SC and ST up to Rs.2,00,000 a year; BC and EBC up to Rs.2,00,000 in towns and Rs.1,50,000 in villages
The bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21 on the wedding day
Only for the bride's first marriage
The bride's mother needs a bank account in her own name. A bride whose parents have died uses her own account
documents: Aadhaar of the bride, her mother and the groom
Caste-cum-nativity certificate and income certificate from MeeSeva (you enter their numbers in the form)
Bride's age proof: SSC hall ticket number, or a birth certificate
Marriage certificate (registration), one wedding photo, and the wedding card if available
First-marriage confirmation certificate and the VRO / Panchayat Secretary certificate
Bank passbooks of the bride's mother and the bride
Bride's photo; SADAREM disability certificate if the bride has a disability

demoSteps: Get the caste-cum-nativity and income certificates from MeeSeva and register the marriage. Scan every document from the original (JPG, 50 to 150 KB).
Open telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in, go to Kalyana Lakshmi and click Registration, or ask a MeeSeva centre to apply for you.

Fill in the bride's details, the mother's bank details, the groom's details and the marriage details, and enter the MeeSeva certificate numbers. Upload the files and submit, then note the application ID and print it.
Take the printout and copies of the documents to the Tahsildar (MRO) office. The Revenue Inspector checks them and the RDO approves.
Track the application with Print/Status on the same page. If there is an objection, correct it through Edit/Uploads.
After sanction, the money is released to the bride's mother's bank account. The local MLA often hands over the sanction at a programme.

schemes.title: Shaadi Mubarak (Rs.1,00,116 Marriage Help for Minorities)
schemes.brief: The Telangana government gives a one-time Rs.1,00,116 for the marriage of a girl from a Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Jain, Buddhist or Parsi family, or Rs.1,25,145 if the bride has a disability. It works like Kalyana Lakshmi: apply online after the nikah or wedding on the Telangana ePASS site or at MeeSeva, then take the printout and documents to the Tahsildar's office. The money is paid into the bride's mother's bank account.

schemes.title: Telangana Construction Workers Registration (BOCW Labour Card)
schemes.department: Telangana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department
schemes.brief: A construction worker registered with the Telangana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board gets an identity card and the board's benefits: Rs.6 lakh if the worker dies in an accident, Rs.1 lakh on natural death, up to Rs.5 lakh for permanent disability, Rs.30,000 for the marriage of a woman worker or of up to two daughters, and Rs.30,000 for each of up to two deliveries. Masons, helpers, painters, carpenters, plumbers, electricians, brick-kiln and road workers and over 50 other trades can register. Fill Form XXVII and give it at the Assistant Labour Officer's office with a work certificate and the Rs.50 fee; membership then costs Rs.12 a year.
schemes.benefit: Rs.6 lakh if the worker dies in an accident; Rs.30,000 each for marriage and for delivery
eligibility: Aged 18 to 60 years
Worked at least 90 days in building or other construction work in the last 12 months
Works as a mason, helper or coolie, painter, carpenter, plumber, electrician, bar bender or centering worker, or in tiles, road, brick-kiln, quarry or another listed construction trade
Works in Telangana; migrant workers from other states can also register
Keeps membership renewed (Rs.12 a year or Rs.60 for five years) to stay eligible for benefits
documents: Filled Form XXVII with two passport-size photos
Aadhaar card
Ration card and voter ID (copies)
Age proof: school certificate or doctor's certificate
Certificate of 90 days' work from the Assistant Labour Officer, a construction workers' union, or a registered builder or establishment
Bank passbook (account number, bank and branch)
Rs.50 registration fee plus Rs.12 for one year (or Rs.60 for five years)
schemes.submitAt: At the office of the Assistant Labour Officer (ALO) for your area, mandal or circle. In Hyderabad, go to the ALO office of your circle. Hand in the filled Form XXVII with two photos and copies of your Aadhaar, ration card, voter ID, bank passbook, age proof and the 90-day work certificate. Pay Rs.50 registration plus Rs.12 for one year or Rs.60 for five years. To renew, pay by challan at any SBI branch and give the challan copy to the same ALO. Claim forms for each benefit are on the Downloads page of tbocwwb.telangana.gov.in.

Get the 90-day work certificate. The ALO can check your work at the site, or your union or builder can certify it.
